extracted.stage: Children and finance matter with a hearing listed at Bristol Family Court
extracted.summary: A partner at Whitlock & Dlamini & Co asks whether £4,000 to cover a single counsel's fee in a Bristol Family Court children and finance matter, with around £161,000 of assets in dispute, meets the minimum loan size.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry, which we have received and logged. To take this further we would need confirmation of your client's details and their consent, the nature and current value of the assets in dispute together with any evidence of them, confirmation of the hearing date and what it is listed for, and a breakdown of the counsel's fee and any further anticipated costs. It would also help to know of any existing charges or competing claims over the assets, and whether any other funding is in place. Once we have those details a member of the team will review the enquiry and come back to you. Nothing in this message should be taken as an offer of funding or an indication of terms.
